description: Read-only flat claims index (data/claims_index.json). Optional filters: org_id, evaluation_id, verified. Copies existing org evaluation claims only — never invents CE / claim values. Prefer verified:true + non-null value when quoting cost-effectiveness. Wave BI provenance on the response. Org narrative fields remain untrusted (ADR 0008). Answers carry decision_brief: the charity's own donate_url (next_action), the evaluator's fund as a let-the-evaluator-choose alternative, the like-for-like comparison page when one exists, and modeled: true / guaranteed: false when figures are present. No figure, rating or order is added.

verified.description: If true/false, filter on claim.verified (string query as HTTP API)
